plan.summary: Add two new flow builder nodes: logic_working_hours (branching node using tenant settings for business hours check) and action_assign_group (terminal node that routes conversation to a specific INMA agent group via callback).
plan.q_intent: flowda mesai saat kontrolü için bir nod lazım. ayrıca inma daki gruplara yönlendirmek içinde bir ayrı node
plan.interview_notes: Mesai node: tenant ayarları kullanılacak (per-node config değil). Grup node: şimdilik manuel group_id girişi (INMA API entegrasyonu ertelendi).

files_changed.change: Added GroupId property to CallbackData + AssignGroup constant to CallbackActions
New branching node handler using WorkingHoursChecker, 2 output handles: within_hours/outside_hours
New terminal node handler storing __assign_group_id and __assign_group_summary variables
Extended Terminal case for action_assign_group + 3 new fields on EngineStepResult
Sub-flow guard + assign_group side-effect block + SendAssignGroupAsync method
2 DI registrations for new handlers + Knowledge timeout change
FlowNodeType union + 2 data interfaces + NodeData union + 2 NODE_TYPE_REGISTRY entries
New node component with clock icon and 2 output handles (green check / red X)
New terminal node component with users icon, displays group_name/group_id
2 SVG icons added to NODE_ICONS record

build.command: dotnet build InvektoServis.sln --no-restore -v q + npx vite build
build.output_tail: Build succeeded. 0 Error(s). 13 Warning(s). + vite build: chunks generated successfully.

non_goals: INMA API integration for group list (deferred)
intentional_exclusions: No INMA API group picker (manual ID input for now)
No off-hours message in working hours node (flow designer uses message_text for that)

user_facing_errors: graph-validator: 'Grup ID bos' warning for empty group_id
error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: AssignGroup callback uses fire-and-forget with ContinueWith logging on failure (same pattern as handoff). Empty group_id logs SystemWarn without sending callback. All node handler exceptions propagate to engine error handling.

aha_moments.user_pain: Flow designer cannot route conversations to specific agent groups, forcing manual reassignment in INMA
aha_moments.suggestion: action_assign_group node with group picker dropdown (future: INMA API integration)
aha_moments.aha_moment: Designer drops a 'Gruba Ata' node, types group ID, and sees conversations auto-routed to the right team

aha_moments.user_pain: Flows cannot check business hours, causing bots to respond during off-hours without context
aha_moments.suggestion: logic_working_hours node using tenant settings for automatic branching
aha_moments.aha_moment: Flow automatically sends different messages during and after business hours without any manual scheduling

aha_moments.user_pain: Setting up business hours logic requires complex condition nodes checking time manually
aha_moments.suggestion: Single drag-and-drop working hours node with tenant-level config reuse
aha_moments.aha_moment: What used to be 5+ condition nodes is now 1 node that just works with existing tenant settings

aha_moments.user_pain: Group assignment requires human intervention - agent must manually transfer to correct group
aha_moments.suggestion: Automated group routing eliminates manual transfer steps in high-volume scenarios
aha_moments.aha_moment: Support lead sees queue times drop because conversations auto-route to specialized groups

aha_moments.user_pain: Prospects contacting outside business hours get generic responses, reducing conversion
aha_moments.suggestion: Working hours branching enables personalized off-hours flows with appointment booking or callback requests
aha_moments.aha_moment: Sales manager sees after-hours leads captured instead of lost, with proper follow-up flow

verification_questions.question: Does LogicWorkingHoursHandler correctly use the singleton WorkingHoursChecker without state mutation or concurrency issues?
Does ActionAssignGroupHandler follow the exact same terminal pattern as ActionHandoffHandler (variable naming, NodeAction.Terminal, no side effects in handler)?
Does the EngineStepResult NeedsAssignGroup field default to false, ensuring existing terminal nodes (handoff, completed) are unaffected?
Does the AutomationOrchestrator assign_group block properly end the session with 'handed_off' status and handle empty group_id gracefully?
Are the frontend types (FlowNodeType union, NodeData union, NODE_TYPE_REGISTRY) consistent with the backend handler node type strings?

verdict.raw_text: Changes add assign_group terminal handling and callbacks without breaking existing flows; error handling and DI registrations follow established patterns.
